Explore the sound of Korn with “Freak On A Leash - Live at Woodstock 99” — a powerful live performance from 1999 that showcases the band’s emotional intensity, dynamic sound, and iconic stage presence. This video features “Freak On A Leash”, performed live at the legendary Woodstock 99 festival, offering a raw and unforgettable glimpse into Korn’s musical journey.

Recorded Live: 7/23/1999 - Woodstock 99 East Stage - Rome, NY
